This is the last remaining hole in the round-3 incident-report fix: any commentary on an incident whose primary move is explanation gets upgraded to first-hand evidence.

Tagging it no_system ('No experiments') contradicts its own 'observed' grade and puts it next to pure essays. eHRo8 (also an observed incident report) gets a model substrate, so the two are treated inconsistently.

It uses Teaching Claude Why and similar papers as examples of the first category; it does not mainly respond to one named work. Under the v3 critique definition, general essays are framework.

The 'evaluation' is the author reading one system-card excerpt and asking Haiku 4.5 to translate it once. behavioural_evals is reserved for running or building a black-box evaluation, so the tag makes an n=1 observation look like an eval.
